name: comp-491

frames.best_why: A settled range from 5 to 10, both ends circled and the days between shaded.

tagline: Month grid where two clicked days shade everything between them.
summary: A single month of dates in a rounded dark panel. Clicking one day then another circles both in white and shades every day between them, with arrows either side of the month name to change month.
appearance: A bordered black panel holds "November 2026" between two small angle arrows, a row of two-letter weekday names, and five weeks of white numbers on black. Chosen days become white circles, the days inside the range sit in a grey band, and a tiny caption sits below.
behaviour: Pressing a day sets one end of the range; moving the pointer across later days stretches a preview band to that day, and pressing again fixes the other end. The frames show the same range rebuilt from 10-13 to 5-10.
demo_content: November 2026, with the days 5 to 10 chosen and the caption "Range calendar - React DayPicker".
search_phrases: pick a start and end date on a calendar
date range picker with shaded days
calendar for booking a stay between two dates
month view with days highlighted between
choose two dates in one month
calendar box with arrows for previous month
booking calendar highlight from one day to another
use_when: Someone must pick a run of consecutive days, such as a booking, a trip or a report window.
avoid_when: Only one month is shown at a time, so a range crossing into the next month takes extra arrow clicks.
customise: The opening range of today plus three days and the caption link are written in the file; borders, padding and month navigation come from the shared calendar.
weight_why: One month of plain date buttons; nothing animates.

a11y.note: Days are real buttons inside a labelled grid and arrow keys move between them; nothing explains the two-click range rule to a screen reader.

issues: The caption credits the calendar library instead of describing the range.
Only one month is visible, so ranges spanning months need manual navigation.
The starting selection is fixed to today plus three days in the code.
polish_why: Crisp month grid, clear range band and rounded endpoints; a library caption and one-month view.
